ns2:course.label: The Holocaust
ns2:course.description: Exploration of the Holocaust in historical perspective by examining European anti-Semitism, political developments in Germany, the rise to power of the Nazis, and the origins of the Holocaust with first-hand accounts, films, and historical texts, concluding with the legacy of the Holocaust in the contemporary world. Same as JS 252.
ns2:course.sectionDegreeAttributes: Camp Honors/Chanc Schol, Humanities - Hist & Phil, and Cultural Studies - Western course.
